title: Additionals
description: A mod that adds more debugging, content and functionality for minecraft itself.
body:
```This mod is now archived, due to being abandoned and mod files have been lost.```


# Additional
This mod should be the debugging and addons you're looking for.
It has:
- Tick checker
- Help Features
- Entity Death Announcer
- And more!

It includes /stop-announce, good for announcing before server stop.
